So the authors' English sits in the base fields, language=Spanish, the _translated columns are empty, text_source=translated_substitute with translation_source=study_supplied. (2) MAPPING IS POSITIONAL, AND WAS CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: data/yandun2026_cognitive.py assigns mem1..mem5 to 0-based columns list(range(9,14)) of each sheet, so the IRW code keeps no trace of the source header. (3) OPTION ANCHORS: the deposit description states the 18 indicators are 'scored on a Likert scale from 1 (Never) to 5 (Always)'. Only the two endpoints are named, so option_text is 'Never' at resp=1 and 'Always' at resp=5 and BLANK at 2, 3 and 4 -- the unlabelled scale points were not padded with their own numbers. This axis (option_text<->resp) is NOT independently verified; it rests on the description's stated direction alone. (4) NO INSTRUCTIONS: the deposit publishes no administered instructions or section prompt, so both are blank rather than filled with the description's prose. (5) PII IN THE RAW SOURCE (not in IRW): column C of both sheets of the source workbook holds the full names of all 50 children. data/yandun2026_cognitive.py never reads that column, so no name reaches the IRW response table or this item-text table, but the CC BY deposit itself carries it -- flagged against the corpus-wide PII rule as a property of the upstream deposit. Same finding as the sibling table yandun2026_logical_thinking (batch_233). (6) RIGHTS: no named commercial instrument. The rubric is the authors' own, first published in this CC BY 4.0 figshare deposit (license block: name 'CC BY 4.0', url https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); no fee, permission-required, non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause exists anywhere in the record, and no row of instrument_rights_register.csv applies. (7) Step 3b instrument-mismatch check: live items are mem1..mem5 on a 1-5 scale, 100 observations each (50 children x 2 waves) -- exactly the Memory dimension's 5 indicators in the deposit, not one of the other three dimensions (Attention 5, Language 4, Logical Thinking 4). Metadata.csv already records 500 responses / 5 items correctly, so the count staleness found on the sibling table does not apply here. Ships.
